description: JUnit test class for VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter, containing multiple test cases that verify the adapter's behavior in handling AMQP connections, message routing, flow control, command handling, and connection counting.

classes.name: VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for testing VertxBasedAmqpProtocolAdapter behavior in various scenarios such as connection handling, message processing, flow control, and connection metrics.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock dependencies and configures the protocol adapter before each test.

methods.name: testStartUsesClientProvidedAmqpServer
methods.description: Validates that an externally provided ProtonServer is used and started by the adapter.

methods.name: testAdapterSupportsAnonymousRelay
methods.description: Checks that the adapter offers the ANONYMOUS-RELAY capability during connection.

methods.name: testAdapterAcceptsAnonymousRelayReceiverOnly
methods.description: Ensures the adapter rejects links with target addresses.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithAtMostOnceDeliverySemantics
methods.description: Verifies handling of 'fire-and-forget' telemetry messages with QoS AT_MOST_ONCE.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithAtLeastOnceDeliverySemantics
methods.description: Verifies handling of reliable telemetry messages requiring acknowledgment with QoS AT_LEAST_ONCE.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Ensures messages are rejected and devices notified if the adapter is disabled for the tenant.

methods.name: testUploadEventFailsForGatewayOfDifferentTenant
methods.description: Verifies that events from a gateway for a different tenant are rejected.

methods.name: testAdapterOpensSenderLinkAndNotifyDownstreamApplication
methods.description: Checks that the adapter opens a sender link and notifies downstream when a device opens a command receiver link.

methods.name: testAdapterClosesCommandConsumerWhenDeviceClosesReceiverLink
methods.description: Confirms proper cleanup when device closes the command link.

methods.name: testAdapterClosesCommandConsumerWhenDeviceClosesConnection
methods.description: Ensures cleanup when device disconnects unexpectedly.

methods.name: testAdapterClosesCommandConsumer
methods.description: Helper method to test closing command consumers on connection loss or device disconnect.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseSucceeds
methods.description: Validates forwarding of command responses downstream.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandAccepted
methods.description: Verifies signaling of successful one-way command execution.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandRejected
methods.description: Verifies signaling of rejected commands.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandReleased
methods.description: Verifies signaling of command release.

methods.name: testOneWayCommandUnsettled
methods.description: Verifies handling of unsettled command deliveries.

methods.name: testConnectionCount
methods.description: Ensures connection count metrics are correctly incremented and decremented.

methods.name: testConnectionCountForAnonymousDevice
methods.description: Checks connection metrics for anonymous devices when auth is not required.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForATelemetryMessage
methods.description: Verifies message rejects and metrics when telemetry message limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForAnEventMessage
methods.description: Checks message rejects for event messages when limits are exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForACommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Verifies command response message rejection when limits are reached.
